key_points.text: The irony of our systems working so well -- technological, corporate, and yes, even political -- is that we've become too comfortable.
Or so argues Tyler Cowen in his new book, The Complacent Class: The Self-Defeating Quest for the American Dream.
We've even outsourced our mobility to immigrants, observes Cowen (who is also a prolific economics blogger, columnist.
